title: Shift Arithmetic
text: Shift bits or binary point of signal, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Bits to shift: Number} sets Bits to shift; {Bits to shift: Source} sets the source of bits, {Bits to shift: Direction} sets the direction in which to shift bits, {Binary points to shift: Number} sets the number of places to shift binary point, {Diagnostic for out of range shift value} sets the diagnostic action and {Check for out-of-range ’Bits to shift’ in generated code} sets the check for out-of-range bits to shift in generated. Values come from the instance.
